_comment: Copy to channels.json to define channels without Supabase. When SUPABASE_URL
and SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY are set, the `channels` table wins and this file is
ignored — the Command Center's Channels page writes that table.
Nothing here is a secret. `credential_ref.ref` names the GitHub Actions secret
(CHRONOS_YT_TOKEN_<REF>) that holds the channel's OAuth token; the token
itself never appears in this file. See docs/MULTI_CHANNEL.md.
competitor_channel_ids: which YouTube channels THIS channel monitors. Omit
the key to inherit COMPETITOR_CHANNEL_IDS (the legacy behaviour); an empty
list means watch nobody. A channel never inherits another channel's rivals.
publish_gate: which pre-publish checks are live. Omit for all of them; only
an explicit false turns one off. shorts: whether this channel also publishes
a vertical Short cut from each video. Off unless enabled is exactly true — a
Short costs another ~1600 YouTube quota units out of 10,000 a day. See
Omitting this file entirely is fully supported: the bot then runs as the
single 'default' channel built from .env, exactly as it did before Phase 5.

agent_config.system_prompt: Explain one financial idea per video through a concrete story. Never give investment advice or price predictions.
agent_config.niche_rules: No tickers in the title. No 'get rich' framing. Always name the risk.
agent_config.visual_style_prompt: Clean modern documentary: city skylines, trading floors, printed ledgers, close-ups of hands and paper.

agent_config.system_prompt: Reconstruct one extinct creature or vanished world per video, from the evidence outward.
agent_config.niche_rules: Say what the fossil record actually shows and where it is uncertain. No invented species.
agent_config.visual_style_prompt: Cinematic prehistoric documentary: primeval forests, volcanic skies, fossil beds, slow drifting camera.
